# Frank Goortani — Architect.Solutions

> Personal CTO portfolio of Frank Goortani — CTO at FasterOutcomes, AI engineering leader, author of "The Centaur CTO" (2026).

Frank is the Chief Technology Officer at FasterOutcomes (AI legal tech, scaling toward Series A). Previously Solution Architect at Uber where he built the award-winning ELLE AI Decision Engine, and Lead Solution Architect at Home Depot Canada. 25+ years in software and architecture, now focused on production AI systems and engineering leadership.

## Pages

- [Home](https://architect.solutions/): About Frank, current work, the book, and contact.
- [Writing](https://architect.solutions/writing/): Articles and essays on AI engineering and CTO leadership.

## Book

- "The Centaur CTO: Leading with AI to Be More Human" (2026): A practical leadership guide for CTOs who want better judgment, stronger teams, and more human impact with AI.

## Companies

- [FasterOutcomes](https://fasteroutcomes.com): Current company (full-time CTO since June 2025).
